# Test data

`noto-serif-14.cpfont`: Noto Serif 2.015 (regular) at 14 px, Latin with its extensions, converted
with `lib/EpdFont/scripts/fontconvert_sdcard.py --intervals latin-ext --size 14 --regular
NotoSerif-Regular.ttf`. Noto Serif is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 ([OFL.txt](OFL.txt)), with
no reserved font name.
